specialty_focus: Daiichi Sankyo focuses on prescription medicines in oncology and cardiovascular disease . Key global and regional flagship products include: Daiichi Sankyo Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan): An antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for HER2-target cancers like breast, lung, and gastric cancers. Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan): A TROP2-directed ADC used for specific types of metastatic breast cancer.
